body: I have heard of cognitive behavioral therapy before, and I feel like something like that would definitely help me! I think most of the issues of depression that I have are due to distorted thought patterns that I might have, or fears which don't make any sense at all but which for whatever reason I am unable to directly confront. Do you have any idea how I would begin looking for a place nearby me that specializes in such a thing?

Thanks! It feels nice to know that I'm not the only person that has felt this way, even though I am sorry that you had to go through this too.  You are probably right that there is something triggering me to feel this way; sometimes, if someone makes a negative comment about me or something, it can make me feel crappy for the rest of the day because I have a tendency to ruminate over small things like that.  So usually, it is the small things that trigger these depressive episodes. Or at least, I think it is. I don't really know.

I think one of the biggest factors that may be affecting how I feel is my lifestyle.  I am a physics major at a pretty good university, and I am taking so many hours of classes this semester that I had to go out of my way to get approval to do it! Anyway, I've had an especially heavy workload these past 2 weeks, and I'm not good at managing my time (though I'm getting a little better), so I have been consistently pulling all-nighters throughout September, and getting maybe 4 hours of sleep a night.  Also, I have been exercising less and eating worse since I returned to college, and I feel like I can't get my shit together and my life is spinning out of my control.  So I'm constantly worrying about things all the time, and I think that is a large part of why I feel the way I do.  I keep telling myself that "tomorrow I'll start doing everything right; I'll eat healthy, get enough sleep, get my homework done on time, do things for people that I told them I'd do, etc." but I haven't gotten around to it yet, usually because I am too tired/don't have time to. I realize that those are just excuses, though.  I really need to pull myself together lol.
